replay_note: Canada · Flights departing 2 November 2026 in each origin airport’s local time, including overnight arrivals. Timeline: UTC; airport boards use local time. New quotes use USD; reused quotes retain their original currencies. Coverage and prices are partial. Empty results mean not returned, not no service. Paths are illustrative.
collection_strategy: Published domestic and Canada/US/Mexico directions, one origin-local date; intact reused worldwide captures, new USD quotes; no Cartesian airport expansion
